# Vocabularies {#sec-vocab}

[Informative]{.status}

Part I defines *how* information is described. This part defines *what* it is described with:
the classes and properties for vessels, observations, vessel data and everything else the framework carries.

Vocabularies are organized as **modules**, one per domain, so that a new domain can be added
— or an existing one extended — without changing the framework itself.

Wherever possible a module **reuses established vocabularies** rather than inventing terms:

- **schema.org** for general-purpose concepts such as organizations, places and events;
- **domain vocabularies** such as Darwin Core [@darwin-core] for biological observations;
- the **NMEA data dictionary** for vessel and instrument data, subject to licensing (below).

Each module states, for every term, its definition, where it comes from, and how it relates to terms in other vocabularies.

## Licensing

Vocabularies are public infrastructure.
Everything in this part, and every machine-readable vocabulary file, is dedicated to the public domain under **CC0**,
so the terms can be copied into any implementation, data catalog or device without conditions.

This applies to the *vocabularies*, not to *data* that uses them: publishers choose the terms of their own information (@sec-rights).
Vocabularies reused from elsewhere keep their own licenses and are referred to by IRI rather than copied.

### NMEA Data Dictionary
The data dictionary for NMEA 0183 Sentences and NMEA 2000 PGNs is distributed under NMEA's standards license.
Users of these bindings should contact NMEA to license these definitions.

## Managing vocabularies

- **Terms are permanent.** A term is never deleted or redefined; it can be deprecated.
  A change that would break existing data needs a new term.
- **Each term has a status:** *proposed*, *stable* or *deprecated*.
- **Anyone can extend.** Because schemas are Things, anyone can define terms in their own namespace without permission.
  This repository governs only the core modules. Widely used extensions can be proposed for inclusion.
- **Namespaces** are not yet decided (@sec-semantic-model).

See [provisional decision 0005](https://github.com/NMEA-Cloud/Framework/blob/main/decisions/0005-vocabulary-management.md).

Vocabularies defined by this document are published as machine-readable files
(see [provisional decision 0007](https://github.com/NMEA-Cloud/Framework/blob/main/decisions/0007-machine-readable-vocabularies.md)).
